manifest.name: 应用市场
manifest.description: 发现官方与社区作品，查看源码来源，衍生创作并安装到桌面。

files.index.html: <!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>应用市场</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="device-ui.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="community.css"></head><body data-atom-app="market"><main id="app"></main><script src="bridge.js"></script><script src="community-preview.js"></script><script src="community.js"></script><script src="app.js"></script></body></html>
files.bridge.js: (function(){'use strict';const waiting=new Map();let serial=0,live=true;window.AtomBridge={live:()=>live,call(action,data){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(!live)return reject(Error('应用已退出'));const id='market-'+Date.now()+'-'+(++serial),timeout=setTimeout(()=>{waiting.delete(id);reject(Error('连接超时，请检查网络后重试'));},20000);waiting.set(id,{resolve,reject,timeout});parent.postMessage({type:'atom:market',id,action,data:data||{}},'*');});},onVoice:null};window.addEventListener('message',function(e){if(e.source!==parent||!live)return;const m=e.data;if(!m)return;if(m.type==='atom:market-result'){const p=waiting.get(m.id);if(!p)return;waiting.delete(m.id);clearTimeout(p.timeout);if(m.error){const err=Error(typeof m.error==='string'?m.error:'操作失败');err.status=m.status;err.code=m.code;err.current=m.current;p.reject(err);}else p.resolve(m.result||{});}if((m.type==='atom:market-voice'||m.type==='atom:notes-voice')&&AtomBridge.onVoice)AtomBridge.onVoice(m);});if(window.AtomApp){AtomApp.deferReady();AtomApp.onSuspend(()=>{live=false;for(const p of waiting.values()){clearTimeout(p.timeout);p.reject(Error('应用已退出'));}waiting.clear();});}})();
